title: Apply user-provided 18-hole Callaway grid defaults and align scoring logic

requirements.text: Update the shipped 18-hole Callaway grid defaults to match the user-provided 13-row table (row number followed by five (grossScore, worstHoles) pairs). Store these values in frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartPersistence.ts within getDefault18GridChart() so a fresh install (no localStorage) uses the new grid.
acceptanceCriteria: With empty browser localStorage, the 18-hole chart displayed in the app matches the provided 13-row table values.
The default 18-hole grid remains exactly 13 rows x 5 columns and passes existing grid validation (numeric values; worstHoles in 0.5 increments; non-negative).

requirements.text: Ensure existing localStorage migration/reset behavior correctly picks up the new shipped 18-hole defaults for users who still have older shipped defaults cached in localStorage (i.e., remove old shipped defaults so the updated shipped defaults are used when appropriate).

quotes: Use English for any user-facing text in the build request.

acceptanceCriteria: If localStorage contains the previous shipped 18-hole grid defaults, the app clears that stored shipped-default data and loads the updated shipped 18-hole defaults.
If localStorage contains a user-edited 18-hole chart (non-shipped-default), the app preserves it and does not overwrite it with shipped defaults.

requirements.text: Align backend Callaway chart logic with the updated 18-hole chart behavior so backend calculations (backend/main.mo) are consistent with the 18-hole grid defaults used by the frontend for scoring.

quotes: I will enter a clean grid for 18 holes in my next post

acceptanceCriteria: Backend Callaway chart thresholds/deductions/adjustments produce results consistent with the updated 18-hole chart behavior used in the frontend for representative gross scores across the chart (including cases that use 0.5 worst-hole deductions and non-zero adjustments if applicable).
Backend continues to trap on non-18-length score submissions as it does currently.

requirements.text: Use English for all user-facing UI strings involved in chart editing, validation, save/reset messaging, and any new messaging introduced by these changes.

quotes: Use English for any user-facing text in the build request.

acceptanceCriteria: No new non-English user-facing strings are introduced in the modified areas (including admin chart editor success/error/reset confirmations).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if an upgrade of stable state is required.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Do not introduce third-party authentication beyond Internet Identity.
nonGoals: Adding 9-hole grid values (not provided in this request).
Adding new external storage/database for chart persistence beyond the existing localStorage approach.
Implementing real-time features or multi-user synchronization for chart edits.
